summary.name: Hocoos
summary.one_liner: Hocoos is an AI website builder that generates professional small-business websites from a short description of your goals, with no coding or design needed.
keywords: pay only if you like it
use_cases: Creating a professional website for a small business quickly
Building an online presence without coding or design skills
Generating website design options from business goals
Optimizing a website for Google search
Editing website content and images with AI assistance
summary.what_it_does: Hocoos asks users to share their business goals, then uses AI to produce three website design options tailored to them. Users pick one and fine-tune it in a click-and-edit editor, where clicking an element offers AI-powered suggestions. The page lists features including an AI content co-writer, free stock images or uploaded images with AI editing (object removal, background expansion), and SEO controls for URLs, page structure and meta descriptions. It also mentions Google Search Console connection and automatic responsive layouts for desktop, tablet and phone. The page describes built-in sales and marketing tools for growing an online business.
notable: Generates three AI website designs from a short business-goals questionnaire
Click-and-edit editor with AI-powered suggestions for any element
Advanced SEO control over URLs, page structure and meta descriptions
Free website offered with payment only if the user likes it
caveats: Listed as paid in the source listing, and the page mentions a pay-if-you-like-it model without giving prices
